critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: mainStyles.ts line 1021 - Platform referenced without import, causing Metro bundler crash. This was a critical regression.

rca_of_issue.issue: Frontend Metro bundler crash: 'Platform is not defined'
rca_of_issue.reproduction: Navigate to https://stencil-gen-staging.preview.emergentagent.com - sees red error screen 'Server Error: Platform is not defined' pointing to mainStyles.ts:1021
rca_of_issue.root_cause: mainStyles.ts uses Platform.OS at line 1021 (for fontFamily), but Platform was not included in the import statement. Only StyleSheet and Dimensions were imported. Metro's bundler evaluates StyleSheet.create() at module load time, so Platform.OS fails before React is even initialized.
rca_of_issue.fix_applied: Added Platform to the import: 'import { StyleSheet, Dimensions, Platform } from react-native;'
rca_of_issue.verification: After fix, Metro rebuilt all 1424 modules. App now loads correctly with welcome screen visible.
